notes: Manufacturer specifications are preferred for hardware capabilities; current store observations are recorded separately and time-stamped.
TOPS values across vendors are not directly comparable because datatype, sparsity and workload differ.
Accelerator memory capacity and supported model/runtime ecosystem are treated as first-class constraints for LLM suitability.

hardware.host_interface: Raspberry Pi 5 PCIe via HAT+ connector
hardware.model_size_practicality: Raspberry Pi documentation states support for LLM/VLM workloads up to approximately 6B parameters; Hailo's currently published GenAI model catalog is concentrated around roughly 1B-3B-class models.
hardware.quantization_compatibility: Hailo-compiled models/HEF; accelerator peak figure is INT4. This is not a drop-in arbitrary GGUF/llama.cpp GPU replacement.
hardware.llm_inference_suitability: Good for purpose-built offline assistants, document/chat appliances, VLM and speech workloads when a supported compiled model fits. Less flexible than CPU/GPU backends for arbitrary models.
hardware.power_efficiency: Very high accelerator efficiency; Hailo-10H typical accelerator power is approximately 2.5 W, excluding Raspberry Pi 5 host power.
hardware.physical_constraints: HAT+ form factor; supplied heatsink and stacking hardware; Raspberry Pi 5 host and adequate cooling/power still required.

pricing.note: Current Raspberry Pi product page displays US$200; this supersedes the US$130 launch price published in January 2026.
PiShop.ca current product price when observed.

hardware.model_size_practicality: Best suited to small LLM/VLM models that fit the 8GB local memory and have Hailo compiler/runtime support. Current published Hailo GenAI examples are mostly 1B-3B class.
hardware.quantization_compatibility: Hailo compiled execution format; INT4 is the peak GenAI performance mode. Arbitrary GGUF compatibility should not be assumed.
hardware.llm_inference_suitability: Excellent power efficiency for supported small GenAI models and embedded appliances; constrained by proprietary compilation/runtime path and smaller model ecosystem than CUDA/ROCm/Metal.

pricing.note: No stable public 8GB module price captured in this pass. Mouser announced global Hailo distribution in July 2026 and lists Hailo-10H starter kits; exact memory configuration must be checked before purchase.

hardware.product: Metis M.2 AI Inference Acceleration Card
hardware.model_size_practicality: The 1GB local DRAM strongly limits general LLM weight residency. Treat as a high-efficiency vision/edge inference accelerator rather than a general local-LLM card unless Axelera publishes a supported GenAI path.
hardware.quantization_compatibility: Vendor quantization toolchain for supported neural networks; 214 TOPS is an INT8 peak figure.
hardware.performance_per_watt_note: Vendor advertises up to 214 INT8 TOPS at 3.5-9 W typical card power; workload-realized efficiency depends on model utilization and host overhead.
hardware.physical_constraints: No-cooling variant is not suitable for deployment without a user-designed thermal solution; active-cooled version is available.

pricing.note: Base no-cooling option; active cooling costs more.

hardware.host_interface: PCIe Gen 3 x4 between RK3588 and Metis AIPU
hardware.model_size_practicality: Large accelerator-memory option is notable, but Axelera currently markets Metis primarily for computer vision and multi-model edge inference. Do not infer broad LLM support from RAM capacity or TOPS alone.

pricing.note: 16GB accelerator-memory configuration; vendor store lists the family from EUR 699.95 to EUR 965.95 depending on memory configuration.

hardware.model_size_practicality: 64GB host memory makes 22B-30B-class quantized CPU/GPU inference plausible by capacity. NPU acceleration depends on CIX software/model support and should not be assumed to work with arbitrary GGUF models.
hardware.quantization_compatibility: NPU documentation advertises INT4/INT8/INT16/FP16/BF16/TF32 acceleration; general llama.cpp/GGUF use may fall back to CPU/GPU paths unless a compatible CIX runtime exists for the model.

pricing.note: Recent tracked price for the listing's cheapest configuration; exact RAM/configuration represented by that price is not guaranteed, so do not treat this as a verified 64GB price.
